errors.text_span: като етикетите се появяват на всеки две години, започвайки от 2001 и завършвайки на 2018
errors.evidence: The chart shows labels for every single year on the x-axis, from 2000 to 2018, not every two years.
The y-axis labels start at 0 and go up to 30000, not from 5000 to 25000.

errors.text_span: БДС на един заем по текущи цени
errors.evidence: The legend text is 'БДС на един зает по текущи цени' (GVA per employed person), not '...заем...' (...loan...).
The final value for the blue line in 2018 is 26017.2, not 27338.8 (which is the value for 2017).
The orange line is marked with circles, not rhombuses.

errors.text_span: БДС на един заем по цени на 2015 г.
errors.evidence: The legend text is 'БДС на един зает по цени на 2015 г.' (GVA per employed person), not '...заем...' (...loan...).
The starting value for the orange line in 2000 is 14300.4, not 15402.2 (which is the value for 2001).
The description does not mention that the blue line is dashed and the orange line is solid.
